about.title: John and Karen's family business
paragraphs: Columbia Climbers is a local, family-run tree service in Washougal, owned by John and Karen Detally.

For over two decades we've taken care of trees across the Columbia River Gorge, from single trims to big fir removals on forested properties. Some of our customers have been calling us for more than 15 years.
We work with homeowners and businesses, and every job starts with a free consultation so we can make a plan that fits your property.

estimate.title: Tell us about your trees.

services.name: Hazard Tree Removal
services.blurb: Leaning, split and storm-damaged trees, taken down carefully.
services.intro: Hazard trees are our specialty. When a tree is cracked, leaning or hanging over your house, we take it down piece by piece and lower it safely to the ground.
photos: Cutting a tree with a chainsaw

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Big firs, maples and more, removed from homes and forested land.
services.intro: From one tree in the backyard to several large firs on acreage, we remove trees safely and clean up after ourselves.

services.name: Tree Trimming
services.blurb: Trimming that keeps your trees healthy and away from your home.
services.intro: Regular trimming keeps your trees healthy and keeps limbs off your roof, power lines and driveway.

services.name: Chipping & Clean-Up
services.blurb: Brush chipped and debris cleared so your property is ready to enjoy.
services.intro: We chip the brush and clear the debris, so your property looks better than when we arrived.
